title: Dragon Ball Daima Deserves to Return for Season 2
content: Dragon Ball Daima did a great job filling in some of the gaps between Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball Super , but the ending still left some unanswered questions . The series built up to the battle with Gomah, which lived up to the hype, but it didn’t get much time to address other plot points.
author: ComicBook

title: Lilo & Stitch Drops First Look at New Animated Revival Ahead of Release in Theaters
content: Lilo & Stitch is coming back to theaters with a new animated revival for the Disney classic, and has dropped the first look images for its new short that fans will be able to check out very soon. Lilo & Stitch has had an eventful few years.
author: ComicBook

title: Kakao, OpenAI Collaborate on AI-Generated Short Animation Based on Ryan Begins Webtoon
content: Kakao announced on November 10 that it has produced Ryan Begins , the first AI short animation starring its popular character Ryan, through a technology collaboration with OpenAI.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Creator Returns With New Look at Ichigo After Anime’s Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War wrapped up the anime’s two decade long run with its final episodes earlier this Fall, and the creator behind it all is helping to celebrate with some special new art for Ichigo Kurosaki.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Reveals First Look at Major Event for the Anime’s Grand Finale
content: My Hero Academia is coming back with a major event to cap off the anime’s tenth anniversary celebration, and now fans have gotten the first look at the new event as it gears up for the anime’s grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Shares First Look at Major Creator’s Return After 3 Years
content: A major creator is returning to the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine with a new series after three years, and Shonen Jump has dropped the first look at their next major project.
author: ComicBook

title: South Park Just Retconned a Major Character With Their Return & It’s a Big Improvement
content: South Park Season 29 has gone back on a major character change made last year, and it is a big improvement as PC Principal is now back to his more classic self with the latest episode. South Park Season 29 has been more of a return to form to the earlier seasons of the animated series.
author: ComicBook

title: Classroom of the Elite: Year 3 Tops Oricon's Light Novel Ranking for October
content: The anime adaptation's fourth and latest season debuted on April 1 and covers the first semester of the Year 2 light novels. The anime will get a fifth season . The second volume of Kinoko Nasu and illustrator Hirokazu Koyama 's Witch on the Holy Night novel series ranked at #2, selling 30,534 copies.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Drops Cool New Look at Chihiro’s Anime Debut
content: Kagurabachi is setting itself up as one of the biggest new anime to make their worldwide debuts next year, and it’s getting even cooler with a much closer look at Chihiro Rokuhira ahead of his big outing.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Episode Release Schedule for 2027 Launch
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has not only confirmed Season 2’s release date ahead of its return in 2027, but the animated series has also revealed the release schedule for all of its future episodes.
author: ComicBook
